notes.title: V1.0.2 UPDATE#2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Since the release of our game we have gotten much more player feedback and bug reporting hence the following bug fixes and changes:

Bug Fixes:
-	Paintballs are visible now.
-	Collision fixes.
-	Fixed dean end of match replication issue.
-	Fixed Map errors.
-	Controls page now auto updates and is scrollable.
-	Fixed discord button
-	Control menu reflects user’s custom key binds
-	Ammo crate material fix
-	Fixed an issue with sliding

Changes:
-	Loose ammo color randomized.
-	Damage indicator color and overlay changed.
-	Double Splat and Triple Splat audio cue.
-	Big JUICY map changes
-	Improved animations (by a lot)3
-	Adjusted movement speed.
-	Movement tweaks
-      Changes to shirley and her picture.

Ammo Economy:
After looking at player feedback we decided to make some changes to the ammo economy:
-	Max ammo reduced to 100
-	Max dropped magazine size reduced to 8 bullets
We will be making more changes to this in the future.


Spawn Camping issue:
We added 1 more door to each spawn to give the player more choices to get out of spawn. We hope to combat this issue further with the upcoming patches


The future of the game:
We will keep supporting this game with future updates as long as we feel stuff can be added and the player count stays around a decent number. Expect some even bigger changes to the map and gameplay soon!

notes.title: Patch V1.01
notes.notes:
V.1.0.1

Patch Notes:
Since the release of our game we have gotten much more player feedback and bug reporting hence the following bug fixes and changes:

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed some minor issues with asset placement.
- Fixed collision issues on certain windows/walls.
- Fixed ammo box audio cue bug.
- Removed damage UI feedback from players of some team.
- Small audio fixes.
- Stylized tree fix
- Collision stutter with magazine drop fix.
- Player dies if they fall out of the map
- Fixed Golf Cart Texture
- Fixed collision on AC doors

Changes:
- Added more Assets (And easter eggs).
- Made it a little bit harder to spawn camp by putting cover in front of the doors.
- Character Model updates.
- Decreased max number of bullets in magazine pickup.
- added 30 second life span to magazine.
- spawn zone buff, impenetrable spawn doors.
- Lighting changes and tweaks
- Removed spawns in entry way of cafeteria.
- Changed color of directional damage indicator to randomize.
- Added paint particle
- Added discord button in the main menu
- Removed the 3rd person key bind

Misc.:
- AZERTY compatibility.

The spawn camping issue:
Since the launch of the game we have noticed a little problem called spawn camping, in this patch we try to combat that with some changes to how the spawns work and changing up the spawn locations. 

Keep in mind some of these changes are temporary! 

This is all still a work in progress and more fixes are bound to happen if we think they are necessary (which they probably are). If you have any feedback you can always send a message in the #help-and-support channel on our discord.

Discord:
We have a discord server for players of the game to communicate and setup games! You can find the link in-game or join using this link: https://discord.gg/mcfz8nhWPf

Thank you!
Thank you to the fans that have been reporting issues and helping this game become better every day!
